notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Shocker.
Shocker does not have summoning sickness.
Psychic Possesion attached to an opponent that has at least two cards in hand.
description:
Activate Shocker by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any opponent.
Shocker triggers, causing the opponent to discard their hand and draw that many cards.
Psychic Possession triggers for each card drawn, causing you to draw that many cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Shocker.
Repeat.
